messages:
Alice M.: heads-up — onboarding sampleapp reranker is failing on a customer repro. Node client returns embeddings of length 1536 but the python sample returns 1024 for the same prompt.
Ben K.: which model + SDK versions?
Alice M.: model: text-embed-3-small, node SDK @1.4.2, python SDK @1.4.2.
Alice M.: repro payload: `[{id: 'q1', text: 'what is redwood?'}]` -> node: `embeddings[0].length = 1536`, python: `len(embeddings[0]) = 1024`
Sam T.: hmm — unrelated but I saw duplicate items in our batcher when auth retry fires. Could be causing downstream mismatch if retried batches get concatenated incorrectly.
Carla R.: do we have logs showing ordering or duplicate ids?
Alice M.: yes, from local run: `INFO batcher: sending batch [q1,q2]`, then `WARN auth: token refresh, retrying`, then `INFO batcher: sending batch [q1,q2]` again, but the SDK merges responses into a flat array without mapping ids back. result array length = 4 and downstream code slices first 2 expecting original order.
Ilya G.: Node vs Python parity note: Node SDK serializes Float32Array -> base64 in the transport helper; python sends list[float]. Are both runtimes reading model vector dims from the model metadata? If Node assumes 1536 from local quantized variant and python hits hosted 1024 variant, that would explain it.
Ben K.: good point. Could also be model variant fallback/routing: smart-routing might send python request to small-variant and node to base variant. Need to log `model_revision` in SDK responses.
SDK Bot: CI: rerank-integration (python) FAILED — embedding-dim-check mismatch detected in smoke test.
Carla R.: proposal: 1) add strict dim assertion in devex batching helper during decode: if any embedding length != expected_dim -> emit structured warn and fail the request; 2) include `vector_dim` and `model_revision` fields in the embeddings response top-level metadata so callers can sanity-check; 3) ensure retry logic uses id->index mapping and dedupes retries.
Sam T.: +1. Also we should make retries idempotent by tracking batch_id and ignoring duplicate responses.
Alice M.: minimal guard snippet I tried: ```js
// after decoding embeddings
const expected = resp.meta?.vector_dim || expected_dim_from_model;
for (const e of resp.embeddings) {
  if (e.length !== expected) {
    throw new Error(`embedding-dim-mismatch: got ${e.length} expected ${expected}`);
  }
}
```
Ben K.: that looks fine as a stop-gap. For SDK parity, add an SDK-level shim: Node should decode to number[] before normalizing; python shim should expose float32 precision if requested.
Ilya G.: I'll add a runtime change so the serving layer returns `x-vector-dim` header and `model_revision` in JSON. That will help root-cause routing differences.
Carla R.: small DX improvement: update sampleapp README to show a `--verify-vec-dim` flag that runs a quick check after onboarding. saves support tickets.
Alice M.: can someone own the patch for the batching helper? I'll take the dim assertion + sampleapp README. Ben — you take retry dedupe mapping?
Ben K.: I can own retry mapping and a unit test that simulates auth refresh mid-batch.
Sam T.: I'll add an e2e flaky test to CI to reproduce duplicate-concat behaviour.
SDK Bot: created task #DEVEX-432: "embeddings: strict-dim-check + retry-dedupe" and assigned to Ben K., Alice M.
Alice M.: thanks — ping me once PRs are up, I'll run the customer repro. :thumbsup:
Ben K.: will do.
Carla R.: follow-up: we should also add a small lint in SDKs that warns if the client consumes `embeddings` by index without using returned ids. plenty of callers assume order.
Ilya G.: agreed. I'll add model_revision to the telemetry so we can query mismatches by customer.
Alice M.: filing a support note for the affected customer now. thanks team.
